THE PROBLEM

The leak isn't visible on your P&L.

It's in the gap between the work you pay for and the work that actually moves the business forward.

Time

Hours go into typing things twice, fixing what got typed wrong, and chasing people for updates.

Money

You find out what a job actually cost after it's finished, not while you can still do something about it.

You

Every decision comes back to you, because nothing else can carry it.

THE POINT

Your tools are not a system.

Buying software is not the same as having something that runs. Most businesses have plenty of the first and none of the second.

Have you bought AI yet?

Nothing needs replacing on day one. We look at the jobs that run on memory and paper, and pick the one costing you most time.

Then we rebuild that one job as a system, applying automation only where it actually saves time.

HOW WE WORK

Look. Decide. Improve.

If a person is copying data between three tabs, a system should be doing it. We map the repetitive work that eats hours every week and engineer it out, without breaking what already works.

01 / Look

The Diagnostic

We work out what is actually happening. Which jobs run on memory, what they cost you in hours, and which one is worth changing first.

02 / Decide

The Build

We rebuild that one job as a working system, inside the tools you already have where that makes sense. You see it running before it takes over.

The Retainer
